# Luxury Media Wall

> Luxury Media Wall designs, builds and installs bespoke media walls, TV walls, TV wall units and feature walls for homes in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah, UAE. Every wall is made to measure in our own workshop and installed by our own team, with the cables hidden inside the wall. Media walls start from AED 8,000. The site survey is free.

## Key facts

- Business: Luxury Media Wall (registered on Google Maps as "Luxury Media Wall and Interior Fit Out")
- Based in: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Areas served: Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah
- Price: media walls from AED 8,000; the final price depends on wall size, materials, storage, display and lighting
- Site survey: free in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah
- Timing: about 2 to 3 weeks of workshop build after the drawing is approved, then 1 to 2 days of installation on site
- Hours: every day, 9:00 to 19:00
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 56 718 5313
- Website: https://luxurymediawall.com/
- Languages: English and Arabic

## Services

- Bespoke media walls with storage, shelving and lighting
- TV walls and TV feature walls (marble, porcelain stone, travertine, fluted oak or walnut, backlit onyx)
- Floating TV units and full-height TV wall units
- LED lighting in shelves, niches and backlit stone
- Hidden cable management for power, HDMI and network
- Entrance walls, consoles with mirrors, walk-in wardrobes and custom joinery
- Interior fit-out

## How to get a quote

Send the wall width, height and a photo on WhatsApp (+971 56 718 5313). We reply with an estimate the same day and confirm the price after the free site survey.
